name: The Chesterfield Mayfair Hotel
positioning: Classic British boutique hotel from The Red Carnation Hotel Collection, spanning three Georgian townhouses on Charles Street in Mayfair
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable Mayfair base near Bond Street and Hyde Park
Guests who like individually designed rooms with a British character

facts.text: The hotel is on Charles Street in Mayfair, a brief walk from Bond Street, Hyde Park, the Royal Academy and Buckingham Palace.
The hotel spans three Georgian townhouses.
Guests are greeted by a top-hatted doorman before a wood-paneled lobby with leather armchairs, antiques and chandeliers.
The hotel is part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection.
Rooms and suites are individually designed, with moods ranging from bold and whimsical to exotic, elegant or cosy.
Rooms have Savoir beds and bespoke Chesterfield linen.
The Chesterfield Suite has plush decor, luxurious furnishings and bespoke amenities.
Butlers Restaurant uses organic, seasonal British ingredients; its signature dish is Dover sole filleted at the table.
The hotel bar, Sem's of Mayfair, is named after the artist Georges Goursat, known as Sem, whose illustrations adorn its walls.
Guests can design a bespoke seven-course menu with the Executive Chef, sourcing ingredients at Borough Market.
The hotel offers a Hidden Wildlife of London Tour through the city's parks with an ecologist and nature guide.
Shepherd Market, one of the oldest parts of Mayfair, is moments from the hotel.

highlights.text: Bedroom fabrics reflect the pinstripes of nearby Savile Row, English cottage-garden florals or the vibrancy of the African savannah.
Stanley's is a rooftop bar above Mayfair with a covered, heated rooftop and blankets on hand.
Suite guests have canapes brought to them each evening.
The hotel offers a women-led Mayfair art tour highlighting female artists and galleries.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes compact room sizes, typical of historic London hotels.
Interconnecting and interleading rooms for four to five people depend on availability and must be booked directly with the reservations team.
WhataHotel notes the traditional style may feel dated to some guests.
